title: 2025 Reunion - The Meeting: Zealous Pursuit
description:
Each May in Richmond, Virginia, we invite shareholders, associates, community members, and friends worldwide to learn, engage, connect and have fun. We call this event the Markel Group Reunion. 

Comprised of two days of events, including a Crawl, Walk & Run, the Forum panels, the Meeting, and the Reception, among other gatherings, the Reunion offers an unparalleled opportunity to better get to know the Markel Group and the community around it. 

This video is a replay of the 2025 Reunion Meeting. 

It includes a tribute to the retiring Tony Markel, the presentation of our Markel Style Award winners, our formal Annual General Meeting (AGM) proceedings, and a question-and-answer section with Markel Group leadership.

Learn more at www.mklreunion.com.
